tasks.analysis: Modern biochemistry focuses on the chemical processes within and related to living organisms.It is a laboratory-based science that combines biology and chemistry.Biochemists investigate how cells function and communicate, exploring the fundamental mechanisms that sustain life.The field has advanced our understanding of how diseases occur and how they can be treated or prevented.Techniques such as molecular cloning and protein analysis are central to biochemistry, leading to innovations in medicine and biotechnology.
